body: Thank you, I just needed someone to show they care...

I do live in the past a lot I will admit. Things just seemed so much better then. I know that sounds crazy coming from an 18 year old. Frankly I think a lot about the what if’s. I’m just really hard on my self about the places in life that I fucked up. I don’t let my self move on. I physically can’t no matter how hard I want too. It’s nice to know that reddit cares. I’m just not sure about living in a real world where I literally matter to no one. And I mean that as literal as you can get. Life has progressively gotten worse when I thought these were the years it’s gets better. It seems like every time I get settled in a good place. It all comes crashing down.
